import { privateContext, failure, json } from '../../../../server/next-boundary';
import { requireBrowserMutation } from '../../../../server/security';
export const runtime='nodejs';
export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
type FixtureState={release?:()=>void;cancelled:number};
const key=Symbol.for('agentflow.test-stream');
const shared=globalThis as typeof globalThis&{[key]?:FixtureState};
function state(){return shared[key]||=( {cancelled:0} );}
export function GET(request:Request){
 try{
  const context=privateContext(request.headers,'human');const fixture=state();let stopped=false;
  const stream=new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
   start(controller){controller.enqueue(new TextEncoder().encode('first\n'));fixture.release=()=>{if(!stopped){controller.enqueue(new TextEncoder().encode('second\n'));controller.close();stopped=true;}};},
   cancel(){stopped=true;fixture.cancelled++;fixture.release=undefined;}
  });
  return new Response(stream,{headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain','Cache-Control':'no-store','AgentFlow-Generation':context.owned.store.metadata().generation}});
 }catch(error){return failure(error);}
}
export async function POST(request:Request){
 try{privateContext(request.headers,'human');requireBrowserMutation(request.headers);const body=await request.json();if(body.action==='release')state().release?.();return json({cancelled:state().cancelled});}catch(error){return failure(error);}
}
